xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5042: PR listing read flaps between ok and failed (catch logs nothing; 100-PR statusCheckRollup query takes ~10s against a 20s timeout)

plan.title: PR listing read flaps between ok and failed (catch logs nothing; 100-PR statusCheckRollup query takes ~10s against a 20s timeout)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: readRepoPullRequests runs one `gh pr list --state all --limit 100` with statusCheckRollup and reviewRequests on every row. On 2026-11-04 GitHub's GraphQL gateway answered HTTP 504 after ~11 s (measured twice in planning), and the catch {} returns null without logging, so the auto-merge scheduler reports 'PR listing unavailable' for minutes at a time and nothing can be auto-merged, with no visible cause. Measured: open PRs with every field 0.75 s; closed PRs without the rollup 2.1 s; closed PRs with the rollup 10.3 s.
narratives.Proposal: Move the GitHub PR listing into src/lib/overdeck/pr-listing.ts (derived-issue-state.ts is at 988 of 1000 lines). Split it into an open read (every field, 30 s TTL, 5 min when none open) and a closed read (no statusCheckRollup/reviewRequests/mergeable, 5 min TTL, 30 s after a failure, re-read when an open PR leaves the open listing). readRepoPullRequests composes them sequentially (open then closed), dedupes by number with the closed row winning, sorts by number descending, and fails if either fails. A new readOpenRepoPullRequests feeds the auto-merge scheduler, merge-path-owner, the UAT ready set and the approval refresher. Every failed read logs its reason ([pr-cache] <repo>: <open|closed> PR listing failed: <reason>) once per change, plus a recovery line. Merged rows without a rollup report checks 'green' (display only); PR sync keeps a link's last observed checks for such rows. Docs and the codebase concerns map record the split and the 504. A PR present in both listings keeps the row from the listing that settled later (reopen-safe). An open PR leaving the open listing bumps a per-repo closed generation and invalidates the closed cache; a combined read re-reads the closed listing once when its closed value predates that generation (in-flight-safe). PR watches never consume a snapshot built from a rollup-less row: such watched keys take the existing gh pr view read, or are dropped from that sweep's notify.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the PrChecksState contract (no 'unknown' value)
- No change to the 20 s exec timeouts
- No change to the GitLab listing (listRepoMergeRequests)
- No change to the 100-row cap of either listing
- No change to the scheduler's null-vs-empty semantics: a failed open read is still 'PR listing unavailable', never 'no PRs'
- No retry or backoff added inside the listing reads
- No frontend change
- No edit to scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt
- A PR that opens and merges inside one 30 s open-listing window may appear in the combined listing up to 5 minutes late; accepted

autoDecisions.summary: Split into an open read with every field and a closed read without statusCheckRollup, reviewRequests and mergeable, rather than limiting the closed set while keeping the rollup.
autoDecisions.rationale: Measured in planning: closed rows with the rollup alone take 10.3 s, at GitHub's GraphQL budget, while closed rows without it take 2.1 s. The issue lists the cheap closed field set as its preferred fix.

autoDecisions.summary: No combined cache: two caches composed sequentially (open, then closed), with the open loader invalidating the closed cache when an open PR leaves the open set.
autoDecisions.rationale: A nested combined cache would let open data age to twice the TTL; parallel reads would let a just-merged PR vanish from the combined listing for one cycle, which makes issues flap between merged and working - the class of bug this issue fixes.

autoDecisions.summary: Closed listing TTL 5 minutes on success, 30 seconds after a failure.
autoDecisions.rationale: Closed rows change only when an open PR closes, which the shrink check catches; a failure must be retried as fast as today.

autoDecisions.summary: Merged rows without a fetched rollup report checks 'green'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified that no decision reads checks on a merged row (deriveState returns 'merged' first; ready/open/schedule/strike readers skip merged rows); without it every merged-not-closed issue shows 'Checks Running' after each dashboard restart. Every Overdeck merge path requires green checks.

autoDecisions.summary: PR sync keeps a link's last observed checks when the listing row has no rollup.
autoDecisions.rationale: A merged snapshot is final and never refreshed, so it must keep the checks last seen while open rather than a guess.

autoDecisions.summary: Open-only consumers (scheduler, merge-path-owner defaultPrOf, listReadyIssuesForProject, listOpenPullRequestsForProject) read the open listing only.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires the open listing to keep feeding listScheduleCandidates; a closed-read failure must never stop scheduling or empty the UAT ready set.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep both exec timeouts at 20 s.
autoDecisions.rationale: GitHub answers 504 at ~11 s, before our timeout; raising it changes nothing.

autoDecisions.summary: Log format: console.warn '[pr-cache] <projectPath>: <open|closed> PR listing failed: <reason>' once per reason change, console.log '... recovered' on the first success after a failure.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors the once-per-change shape auto-merge-skip-reasons.ts already uses; the issue asks for the reason once per state change.

autoDecisions.summary: Extract the listing into src/lib/overdeck/pr-listing.ts with re-exports from derived-issue-state.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: derived-issue-state.ts is at 988 of the 1000-line ceiling and allowlist raises are operator-only; re-exports keep every importer unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: Plan-critic findings (reopen, in-flight closed read, false watch checks-passed) accepted and resolved by a freshness rule for duplicate rows, a closed generation with one bounded re-read, and an unobserved-row rule for PR watches.
autoDecisions.rationale: Each finding named a real interleaving in the cache or watch code; see '## Critique response' in the PRD.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 (D1, D3-D7, D12, D13). In pr-listing.ts: add GH_CLOSED_PR_FIELDS = 'number,url,title,state,mergedAt,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName,isDraft,reviewDecision,updatedAt,closedAt,author'. Replace cachedRepoPullRequests with cachedOpenPullRequests (value SettledListing {rows, settledAt} | null, ttlFor = prListingTtlMs(listing?.rows ?? null, PR_CACHE_TTL_MS)) and cachedClosedPullRequests (value SettledListing | null, ttlFor = listing ? PR_CACHE_IDLE_TTL_MS : PR_CACHE_TTL_MS). Open loader: skip gate -> {rows: [], settledAt}; else runGh pr list --state open --limit 100 --json GH_PR_FIELDS (caller pr-cache, timeout 20_000) -> {rows, settledAt: Date.now()}; catch -> null. Closed loader: skip gate; runGh pr list --state closed --limit 100 --json GH_CLOSED_PR_FIELDS -> {rows, settledAt}; catch -> null. Export readOpenRepoPullRequests. readRepoPullRequests: await open; null -> null; await closed (sequential, never Promise.all); null -> null; rows = combineListings(open, closed) where a number present in both keeps the row from the listing that settled later (open wins only when open.settledAt > closed.settledAt), sorted by number descending; lastRepoPullRequests.set(projectPath, { rows, settledAt: open.settledAt }). invalidateRepoPullRequests invalidates both caches. Rewrite the PR_LISTING_MAX_STALE_MS doc comment (drop the '--state all ... ~11s' sentence; state the split and the measured 504). Re-export readOpenRepoPullRequests from derived-issue-state.ts and from src/dashboard/server/services/derived-issue-state.ts. In derived-issue-state.ts (same file, so open-pr-listing.test.ts never sees two runGh calls): listReadyIssuesForProject (line 856) defaults to `async (p) => (await readOpenRepoPullRequests(p)) ?? []`, and listOpenPullRequestsForProject (line 883) reads `(await readOpenRepoPullRequests(projectPath)) ?? []` on the GitHub branch. The shrink rule and closed generation are NOT in this item (closed-listing-consistency). Tests (fake timers): make the gh stub in derived-issue-state-pr-listing.test.ts answer by the --state argument, fix its header ('--limit 200'), add the PRD WI-2 cases including the reopen case; update derived-issue-state-quota.test.ts to assert the open and closed calls and that the closed args omit statusCheckRollup, reviewRequests and mergeable; open-pr-listing.test.ts asserts its single runGh call has '--state', 'open'.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-9 (D2, D14). In pr-listing.ts add lastOpenNumbers: Map<string, ReadonlySet<number>> and closedGeneration: Map<string, number>; the closed cache value becomes ClosedListing = SettledListing & { generation: number }. Open loader after a successful parse: if a previous number set exists and any of its numbers is missing from the new set, increment closedGeneration for the repo and call cachedClosedPullRequests.invalidate(projectPath); store the new set; all before returning. Closed loader: read the generation BEFORE runGh and return it in the value. readRepoPullRequests after the open null-check: const seen = closedGeneration.get(projectPath) ?? 0; read closed; if closed && closed.generation < seen, invalidate the closed cache and read closed exactly once more (no loop). Tests with deferred, --state-keyed gh answers and fake timers: the shrink case and the in-flight case described in PRD WI-9.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3 (D10, FR-3). In pr-listing.ts export pure describePrListingFailure(error: unknown): string. Order: GitHubQuotaPausedError (instanceof, import from ../github-quota/pause-gate.js) -> 'quota pause: <message>'; GitHubRateLimitedError -> 'rate limited: <message>'; error.code === 'ERR_CHILD_PROCESS_STDIO_MAXBUFFER' -> 'output exceeded maxBuffer' (checked before killed, since Node sets killed for it too); error.killed === true -> 'timed out after 20s'; non-empty string stderr -> first non-empty stderr line trimmed; else first line of error.message or String(error) trimmed; cut to 200 chars. Keep lastFailureLogged Map keyed `${projectPath}\0${listing}` (listing 'open' | 'closed'). In both loaders' catch: when the reason differs from the stored one, console.warn(`[pr-cache] ${projectPath}: ${listing} PR listing failed: ${reason}`) and store it. On success, when the key is stored, console.log(`[pr-cache] ${projectPath}: ${listing} PR listing recovered`) and delete it. Update the PAN-4264 loader comments to say the failure is logged. New test file tests/unit/lib/overdeck/pr-listing-failure.test.ts with fake timers, mocking run-gh.js and shouldListPullRequests -> true, and console.warn/console.log spies.
